info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Luxembourg API
Returns daily files from Open:FactSet Partner - Luxembourg

params.name: _sort
params.description: Enables to get the data in ascending or descending order based on startTime. Results are in reverse chronological order if this parameter is not used.

params.name: _paginationLimit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of results to return per result.

params.name: _paginationOffset
params.description: Specifies the starting point for pagination. This parameter is used to identify the beginning of next set of results. Using this parameter can fetch maximum of first 10000 records.

params.name: isin
params.description: Specifies the ISIN of the record.

params.name: preissuancePubDate
params.description: The pre-issuance date of the record.

params.name: type
params.description: Please input the value as **idMap** to get the symbology files

items.docs: Returns XML files and relevant metadata provided by Open: FactSet Partner – Luxembourg.
